title: Private entry & bath in the Heart of the City.
description:
Eclectic private room and bath with its own entry.   Everything you need to enjoy your stay in Nashville!  The best part... Only 5mins /$8 Uber to Broadway downtown. 

The  cozy room has 1 full daybed w/ a twin trundle bed underneath. 
Blocks away from restaurants, shopping, grocery and drug store, farmers market and entertainment.

The space
Room is private, cozy and comfortable with private bath.  Located downstairs and have direct access to an outside door. 

Parking available in private driveway.

Guest have access  bedroom and bath. 

There's a small refrigerator, microwave and coffee maker in room. Hair blow dryer is also available in bath.

Guest access
Guest have direct access to room from outside entry. If I'm not able to meet guest upon their arrival, keys are left in the key lock box.

During your stay
Varies with my schedule of the week which changes frequently.  I try my best to ALWAYS meet and greet guest.

Other things to note
There's a small refrigerator, microwave and coffee pot in room.  Paper plates, plastic utensils, paper towels and cups area available.  Hair blow dryer along with liquid soap is also available in bath.
